sentence_stem: Although the novel was long and difficult,
correct_completion: many readers finished it in a single week.
full_sentence: Although the novel was long and difficult, many readers finished it in a single week.
acceptable_variants: many readers still praised its style.

options.text: so readers quickly lost interest in it.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'although' requires a contrast with the first clause, not a consequence.

options.text: it had been written in a single week.
options.why_wrong: This gives background information about writing the novel but does not set up a contrast with its length and difficulty.

options.text: the author was born in a small village.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated fact that does not complete the contrast set up by 'although'.

options.text: many readers finished it in a single week.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners whose first language uses different concessive structures often choose a cause clause here by mistake, so it helps to check whether the second clause goes against the expectation set by the first.
translation: Aunque la novela era larga y difícil, muchos lectores la terminaron en una sola semana.
